title: Production readiness: frontend verification flow and heartbeat diagnostics

requirements.summary: Add production verification support in the frontend: documented pre-release checklist and a user-visible backend heartbeat reachability check integrated into troubleshooting/diagnostics UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users can load the app, browse published stories, and the home/feed pages render without fatal errors.
A user can log in with Internet Identity, submit a story successfully, and then see it listed in “My Submissions” as pending.
A logged-in user can add a comment and a review to a published story without authorization errors.
Admin moderation workflows still require admin permissions and are not accidentally granted to normal users.
The app’s troubleshooting/availability check flow can successfully call the backend heartbeat and show backend reachability when the backend is up.

file_operations.description: Add a concise pre-release verification checklist for the deployed environment, covering: anonymous browsing (home/feed/story pages), Internet Identity login/logout behavior (including React Query cache clearing), end-to-end submit-story flow and pending visibility in “My Submissions”, commenting/reviewing a published story, confirming admin-only routes/actions remain restricted, and confirming backend reachability via the heartbeat check shown in the UI. Use English for all text.

Create a small diagnostics component that uses the existing backend capability check via the useBackendAvailability hook to run an explicit heartbeat check on user action and render clear states (idle/checking/reachable/unreachable) with any error message. Use shadcn-ui primitives (e.g., Card/Alert/Button) to present results. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Integrate the new BackendHeartbeatCheck component into the troubleshooting UI so users can explicitly run a backend heartbeat check and see reachability. Keep user-facing text in English and reuse existing layout/styling patterns. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Tighten the feed failure diagnostics to better distinguish backend reachability vs. other failures by ensuring the heartbeat-driven state is surfaced consistently when story loading fails (reuse existing useBackendAvailability behavior) and provide a clear call-to-action to retry and/or open troubleshooting. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
